purpose: Canonical umbrella and subcategory registry for rail organization, access-surface routing, rail filtering, stagnant-vs-scrolling behavior, and future customization controls.
rules: Every rail item must map to exactly one primary umbrella.
Every rail item may map to one or more secondary umbrellas only when it genuinely crosses access paths.
Every subcategory must declare at least one access path.
Access paths may be plural lists, singular entity pages, workflow pages, public/client/staff/admin variants, API/data routes, rail surfaces, or proof routes.
UI color, motion, pinning, visibility, and customization should read this registry instead of inferring category meaning from labels.
Role-specific access paths are not security boundaries. Server-side route policy, server actions, API auth, and tenant scoping still own enforcement.
